summary: Gabriel Gutierrez campaigns for Gavilan College Area 3 trustee on a platform of free tuition, student housing, labor agreements, and campus security. The sole Palestine-relevant item in his record is a general-election endorsement from CAIR Action, an advocacy organization whose recommendations weigh civil rights and foreign policy including Gaza ceasefire positions. That full-tier endorsement, distinct from a preliminary preference, anchors this assessment.
